notes: Gold set v2 for brief 09 (PLAN.md 5.1), written 2026-09-29 before any database run. It replaces questions_v1.json (72 draft questions); some v1 topics were kept, but every fact, span and question was re-checked against the source text and the built corpus files.

108 core questions (T 48, S-EN 20, S-AR 20, U 20) plus 8 optional D questions. Every core fact_id is asked once in English and once in Arabic (twin_of links the two), so each language comparison runs on identical facts. T facts come from the 12 EN/AR twin pairs; S-EN from English-only documents (5 India, 5 Gulf); S-AR from Arabic-only documents; U topics are absent from the corpus (absence_check lists the terms verified absent); D questions are Gulf-dialect paraphrases of T Arabic questions, retrieval layer only, never in a headline.

doc_lang: en or ar for single-language gold documents, both for twin pairs (T, D), none for U. gold_docs uses manifest ids. corpus_format pdf or docx picks the staged file of a Gulf document; spans are validated against both.

evidence_spans: 1 span for S questions, 2 for T and D (span_docs[i] names the twin that contains span i, so masked retrieval keeps one span). A span is verbatim from one segment of the source body (paragraph, list item, heading or one table cell) with the ** emphasis markers removed; no harakat or tatweel; Arabic spans contain no Latin letters and English spans no Arabic letters; at most 100 characters; unique in its document. Match a span with match_key() in validate_gold.py: build_corpus.norm() then all whitespace removed, because pdftotext moves spaces next to digits inside Arabic text. An evidence hit should count only in a chunk whose ATTRIBUTES.object_name is a gold document of the question. span_has_fact[i] says whether span i itself contains a fact value; when it is false (a table row label, a column header or a sentence next to the value), the hit also requires a fact alternative (number on a boundary) in the same chunk, so a label retrieved without its value is not counted.

facts: every group must be matched (any alternative); numeric alternatives come with their Arabic-Indic forms. forbidden: values that must not appear in a correct answer: other locations, India counterparts, superseded GLF-E04-EN values, statutory values, and (forbidden_siblings) every number in the same table row and column as the fact cell, except sibling_exempt values that a complete correct answer may legitimately state. An answer with all facts and a forbidden value is scored contaminated, not correct, and goes to human audit. counterparts names the other document each cross-document forbidden value comes from (India, superseded GLF-E04-EN or another Gulf policy); test_questions.py checks the value occurs there, and the india_vs_gulf and superseded tags are set exactly when such a counterpart exists.

Non-guessable facts: no fact equals a UAE, KSA or Qatar statutory value for the same entitlement (listed in statutory, and always forbidden), nor 30, 60, 90 or 12; no fact comes from META (version, effective and review dates) or the footer.

split: fact ids are ordered by sha256(fact_id) inside each bucket and the first ceil(n/3) are dev (T 8 of 24, S-EN 4 of 10, S-AR 4 of 10, U 4 of 10: 40 dev and 68 test core questions). D questions take the split of the T fact they paraphrase so no test fact leaks into dev. Dev drives every winner and calibration; test carries every headline.

overlap_ratio is the share of the question's distinct words found in its spans; max_shared_run is the longest shared run of consecutive words and is always below 4. Report results by overlap_ratio tercile.
The Arabic questions and documents were written by the same LLM author and have not been reviewed by a native speaker; the post must say so.

Derived fields (split, span_docs, overlap_ratio, max_shared_run, forbidden_siblings, the forbidden merge and sealed_sha256_of_questions) are written by validate_gold.py --write. sealed_sha256_of_questions is the sha256 of json.dumps(questions, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')). Any later change goes through P17 only and is logged with its reason.
